name: codebase-qa-codragraph-monorepo-v1
description: 105 hand-labeled Q&A tasks against the codragraph monorepo. Mix of: (a) what does X do, (b) where is Y called, (c) what breaks if Z changes, (d) which file defines W, (e) cross-package, (f) language-specific MRO and call-resolution, (g) protocol/format, (h) build/CI, (i) brand and product roadmap. Used as the search-set for codragraph-harness Phase 1.

tasks.question: Where is the parse phase defined?
Which phase produces Section nodes from markdown files?
What does the impact MCP tool return?
tasks.expectedAnswer: Blast radius: a list of upstream/downstream symbols affected by changing the target, each with a depth and a risk level.
acceptParaphrases: upstream/downstream affected symbols with risk level

tasks.question: Which package owns the React UI?
What graph database does codragraph use for the indexed knowledge graph?

Which language is the only current implementer of inferImplicitReceiver?
What is the search algorithm used by the query MCP tool?
tasks.expectedAnswer: Hybrid BM25 + semantic vector merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (K=60)
acceptParaphrases: BM25 plus vector with reciprocal rank fusion

tasks.question: What suffix do node ids use for overloaded methods?
tasks.expectedAnswer: #<paramCount> arity suffix; type-hash ~type1,type2 added on same-arity collision

tasks.question: Where is the Pareto frontier implementation in codragraph-harness?
What three objectives does the codragraph-harness Pareto frontier optimize?
tasks.expectedAnswer: accuracy (higher is better), tokens (lower is better), latencyMs (lower is better)

acceptParaphrases: cli, web, harness, compress, graphstore, and org

tasks.expectedAnswer: husky with lint-staged (prettier + tsc only — tests run in CI)

tasks.expectedAnswer: import-resolved, global, local-call (plus same-file, interface-dispatch, read, write across both pipelines)

tasks.question: What is the hard memory ceiling that disables embedding generation?
